name: The Mathematician
tagline: Calls when the odds say so, bets when they say so loudly, and never bluffs.

edge.desc: How much the chance of winning beats the pot odds

profitable_call.desc: Does the chance of winning beat the pot odds?

strong_edge.desc: A big enough edge to bet or raise for value: 20 points over the pot odds facing a bet, or a 60% chance of winning when a check is free

table.why: Facing a bet, the chance of winning beats the pot odds by 20 points or more; or a free check, and a 60% chance of winning: bet for value.
The chance of winning beats the pot odds: calling is profitable.
Nothing to call and no edge worth betting: check and see the next card.
The call costs a bigger share of the pot than the chance of winning: fold.

raise_to.desc: The total bet when raising: three big blinds to open before the flop, three times the bet facing a raise, two thirds of the pot after the flop
raise_to.expr: if street = "preflop" then (if raises = 0 then 3 * big_blind else 3 * current_bet) else decimal(pot * 0.66, 0)
